title: Webhooks
intro: Receive booking and interest-table events in your own system as they happen. All events for this restaurant go to one endpoint — your system reads the eventType field and acts on what it needs.

toggle.label: Webhooks
toggle.lockedHint: Save your endpoint and bearer token before enabling webhooks.
toggle.onContent: We'll start posting events to your saved endpoint as they occur.
toggle.offContent: We'll stop posting events to your endpoint immediately. Events that fire while webhooks are off are not sent or emailed.
toggle.onToast: Webhooks are on. We'll post events as they occur.
toggle.offToast: Webhooks are off. Events that fire now are not sent or emailed.

errors.notConfigured: Save your endpoint and bearer token first.
errors.validation: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.sub: A single public HTTPS URL where we POST every event for this restaurant. Return a 2xx to acknowledge — anything else is retried.
endpoint.label: Endpoint URL
endpoint.hint: HTTPS only. One endpoint per restaurant — filter by event type on your side.
endpoint.hostError: Enter a full hostname, for example https://api.yourdomain.com/hooks.
endpoint.tooLongError: Endpoint URL must be 2,048 characters or fewer.

auth.title: Authorization
auth.sub: We send this as a Bearer token in the Authorization header on every delivery, so your endpoint can confirm the request is allowed. Required — we never post to an unauthenticated endpoint.
auth.label: Bearer token
auth.hint: Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> on every request. Treat it like a password.
auth.requiredError: Bearer token is required — we never post to an unauthenticated endpoint.
auth.tooLongError: Bearer token must be 500 characters or fewer.

secret.title: Signing secret
secret.sub: We sign every request body with this secret and send the signature in a header, so you can confirm the request came from GoMingle and wasn't altered. Shown in full once when generated.
secret.placeholder: No secret yet — save your endpoint to generate one.
secret.hint: Shown in full only when generated or rotated. The last four characters tell you which secret is live.
secret.rotateBody: There is no grace period — the current secret stops working the moment you rotate. Your system will stop verifying payloads until you update it with the new one.

reveal.title: Copy your signing secret
reveal.body: This is the only time we'll show it in full. Copy it now and store it securely — if you lose it you'll need to rotate for a new one.

save.msg: Endpoint, authorization and delivery status are saved together.

events.title: Events you'll receive
events.sub: Two independent streams, delivered in order per table and per booking. Expand any event to see a sample payload.
events.titleTooltip: All 7 events are always delivered — filter by eventType on your side. Standard events retry then fall back to email on failure. The interest-table Published event is gating: if it can't be delivered, that table's later events wait on email until it's resolved.
events.legend: Standard events are delivered on their own — if one can't be delivered it's retried, then emailed, and the rest of the stream carries on. Gating applies only to the interest-table Published event: if we can't deliver it, that table's later events switch to email until it's sorted. Booking events are always standard.

delivery.title: How delivery works
delivery.sub: Retries and email fallback are automatic — there's nothing to set up.
delivery.retriesBody: On a 5xx, timeout or connection error we retry every 15 minutes, up to 10 attempts. A 4xx fails immediately.
delivery.emailBody: If an event can't be delivered after retries, we email it to your restaurant's contact email so nothing is missed.

test.title: Test your endpoint
test.sub: Send a sample of any event to your endpoint to confirm connectivity and signature checks before going live.
test.label: Event to send
test.labelTooltip: Sends a real sample payload of the chosen event to your saved endpoint. It's marked as a test in the payload and appears in the log below, so it's easy to tell apart from live traffic.
test.hint: Test events are marked as tests in the payload and show in the log below, so they're easy to tell apart from live traffic.
test.queuedToast: Test queued — check Recent deliveries for the result.
test.needsConfig: Save your endpoint and bearer token before sending a test.
test.awaiting: Test accepted. Waiting for it to appear in Recent deliveries…
test.awaitingStale: Still not in Recent deliveries. Open that tab and refresh — the log can lag behind.

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.queuedStale: Not recorded yet — refresh to check again
deliveries.emptyHint: Configure and enable webhooks to start receiving events.
deliveries.emptyFilteredHint: Nothing in the last 30 days has this status. Switch back to All to see every delivery.
deliveries.note: We log each delivery's status, attempt count and a short reason if it didn't get through. We don't store the response your endpoint returns — capture request or response detail on your side if you need it.
